name: @salesforce-ux/design-system-2
description: Salesforce Lightning Design System 2 (SLDS 2), is a complete design framework that helps you create consistent, accessible, and scalable user interfaces across its applications and platform.

scripts.dev: yarn build:dev && yarn build:compliance-reports && run-p watch watch:css watch:uif watch:compliance storybook
scripts.dev:debug: run-p build:assets build:js build:component-assets && yarn build:registry:debug && yarn build:css:dev && run-p watch watch:css storybook
scripts.build:dev: yarn run -T turbo build --filter=^... && run-p build:assets build:js build:component-assets build:registry build:uif && yarn build:css:dev && yarn build:legacy-hooks && yarn build:catalog
scripts.build:production: yarn run -T turbo build --filter=^... && run-p build:css:production build:uif build:component-assets build:pearl-theme && yarn build:legacy-hooks && yarn build:catalog && cp README.consumer.md dist/README.md
scripts.build:css: yarn run -T turbo build --filter=^... && run-p build:css:dev-standard build:css:dev-theme-layer build:css:production
scripts.build:css:dev: yarn run -T turbo build --filter=^... && run-p build:css:dev-standard build:css:dev-theme-layer
scripts.build-storybook: yarn build && yarn build:compliance-reports && storybook build -c ${STORYBOOK_CONFIG_DIR:-.storybook} -o ${STORYBOOK_OUTPUT_DIR:-../../storybook-static} --stats-json
scripts.publish:internal: yarn build:production && cd dist && npm publish --registry=https://nexus.soma.salesforce.com/nexus/content/repositories/npmjs-internal/
scripts.prepack: cp ../../LICENSE.txt . && cp README.md README.dev.bak && cp README.consumer.md README.md
scripts.storybook:sitedocs: yarn build:dev && run-p watch watch:css watch:uif storybook:sitedocs:server
